title: Why I don't use Time Machine anymore and how Dotfiles helped me to level up my backup strategy
content:
<html><head></head><body>Last month I have been through hell while my laptop broke one week before my book release. I had a full backup, but it turned out restoring it is not always as easy as you might think. In this article, I tell you my backup story, why I abandoned Apple Time Machine and how Dotfiles help me now.
            </body></html>
